maintenance.repairConfirm:
Applies only to Codex data; Claude is not affected.

Back up the database, verify log indexes and recalculate weekly capacity. Unassigned records in the current cycle require separate ownership confirmation. Account or cycle boundaries and incomplete logs will not be forcibly merged; unsafe intervals remain excluded.
maintenance.clearConfirm:
Applies only to Codex data; Claude is not affected.

Clear weekly estimate history, samples and caches for all accounts and set a new calculation floor so old estimates do not reappear. Raw logs, Token records, confirmed ownership and original quota observations remain intact. A backup is created first. Future snapshots can start new sampling. Continue?
maintenance.restartConfirm:
Applies only to Codex data; Claude is not affected.

Keep estimate history and start a new sample from the current account and quota. Previous samples will not contribute to this run. Token records and ownership remain unchanged. A backup is created first. Continue?

capacity.stableNote: v4: pair non-overlapping blocks of at least 3 percentage points; confirm endpoints using later quota and an index scan at least 2 minutes later. Weekly API-equivalent value = total priced cost × 100 / total paired percentage points. Late logs replace the affected blocks. Account, plan, pricing and reset boundaries remain separate. The reference range describes block variability, not official dollar credit or a statistical confidence interval; it may widen as usage changes. Old results remain historical references until two new blocks are ready.

attribution.explanation:
Applies only to Codex data; Claude is not affected.

Current filtered range only. Unassigned means continuous login evidence is missing, possibly while the app was closed, starting, or verifying the account. Old logs cannot prove the exact cause; this does not imply another account. Confirmation applies only to previewed unassigned records on the selected date, never other accounts or source logs. A database backup is created first.

Token capacity = eligible interval tokens / corresponding weekly percentage points used × 100. Dollar estimates use API-equivalent costs from the same interval; missing prices yield partial estimates.

User-confirmed attribution and late logs replace recomputed intervals rather than adding duplicates. Missing timestamps or endpoints, account/plan/reset boundaries and unverified ownership are excluded.
